b6_reason: Statement I is correct (O2 competes with CO2 at RuBisCO, lowering CO2 fixation), but Statement II is reversed: in C4 plants mesophyll cells use PEP carboxylase and show no photorespiration, while bundle sheath cells show very little because CO2 is concentrated there.
